entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
This contempt petition has been filed for non-compliance of the order dated 13.01.2025 passed in W.P.(C) No.383 of 2025.

The operative part of the order reads as follows:
"Considering the submission made and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court disposes of the writ petition directing the opposite party no.3 to dispose of the L.A. Case No. 18 of 2000 in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order and communicate the result of such exercise to the petitioner.

It is further directed that in case the application of the petitioner under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 is allowed, and there is no other legal impediment, the compensation amount be disbursed in favour of the petitioner within a period of two months thereafter."

As per order dated 28.10.2025, learned counsel for the State has produced the written instruction dated 04.11.2025 received from the Spl. L.A. & R.R.O., Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar wherein it is stated as follows:
" In inviting a reference to the letter on the subject cited above, I am to say that as per Kshirasindhu Kata vs Kailash Chandra Das on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122057252/
1 kind orders of the Hon'ble High Court of Orissa passed in W.P.(C) ANo.383/2025,
the application filed by Kshirasindhu Kata u/s.28(A) LA Act 1894 has been taken up at this level.

entities.text: Kshirasindhu Kata vs Kailash Chandra Das
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Notice has been issued to the petitioner for hearing her petition vide this office Notice No.608 dtd.22.07.2025.
The petitioner and other legal heirs of the RT were present on 29.07.2025.
During hearing the petition, it was noticed that the petitioner of this case has put signature in the Hazira.
On verification of the petition filed by the petitioner u/s.28(A) of LA Act, 1894 on 30.05.2023, she put her thumb impression in the petition for which the petition has been disposed due to suspect.
The copy of the notice, Hazira and Petition u/s.28(A) of LA Act, 1894 are enclosed for kind reference.

I would, therefore, request you to please apprise the Hon'ble High Court of Orissa in this regard and pray for allowing 3 months of time for disposal of the petition u/s.28(A) of LA Act, 1894 of Kshirasindhu Kata W/o. Late Benudhar Kata of village Belgaon."
The written instruction is taken on record.
In view of such state of affairs, we grant three months time for disposal of the petition filed by the petitioner under section 28(A) of LA Act, 1894.
Accordingly, the CONTC stands disposed of.

( S.K. Sahoo) Judge (Chittaranjan Dash) Judge PKSahoo Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA Kshirasindhu Kata vs Kailash Chandra Das on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122057252/
